mapper.sql: t.owner_id AS task_owner_id,t.id AS actual_task_id,t.purpose,t.status AS task_status, d.owner_id AS decision_owner_id,d.task_id AS decision_task_id,d.status AS decision_status,d.mode, d.target_item_id,d.target_version_id, q.owner_id AS question_decision_owner_id,q.task_id AS question_decision_task_id,q.status AS question_decision_status, q.target_question_id AS question_target_item_id,q.target_version_id AS question_target_version_id, target_item.owner_id AS target_item_owner_id,target.owner_id AS target_version_owner_id, target.item_id AS actual_target_item_id,target.id AS actual_target_version_id, target.version_number AS actual_target_version_number

LEFT JOIN ai_task t ON t.owner_id=s.owner_id AND t.id=s.task_id LEFT JOIN ai_candidate_decision d ON d.owner_id=s.owner_id AND d.task_id=s.task_id LEFT JOIN ai_question_decision q ON q.owner_id=s.owner_id AND q.task_id=s.task_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_item target_item ON target_item.owner_id=d.owner_id AND target_item.id=d.target_item_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version target ON target.owner_id=d.owner_id AND target.item_id=d.target_item_id AND target.id=d.target_version_id
mapper.select: SELECT v.owner_id,v.item_id,v.id AS version_id,v.version_number,v.title, i.owner_id AS item_owner_id,i.kind AS item_kind,i.status AS item_status, i.current_version_id,i.version_number AS current_version_number, current_version.owner_id AS current_owner_id,current_version.item_id AS current_item_id, current_version.id AS actual_current_version_id,current_version.version_number AS actual_current_version_number FROM knowledge_version v LEFT JOIN knowledge_item i ON i.owner_id=v.owner_id AND i.id=v.item_id LEFT JOIN knowledge_version current_version ON current_version.owner_id=i.owner_id AND current_version.item_id=i.id AND current_version.id=i.current_version_id WHERE v.owner_id=#{owner} AND v.item_id=#{itemId} AND v.id=#{versionId}
